note: Spec-bots §6 named error injections. Probability per opportunity at each rank anchor (Iron .. Challenger); linear in skill between anchors (bot skill after variance). Order of values: iron, bronze, silver, gold, platinum, emerald, diamond, master, grandmaster, challenger. Logged as injectedError for the post-game. BRAIN-REWORK §9 (A3): durS = how long the bot stays in the mistake (s, same rank order, interpolated); after it the bot notices (detect: what it notices) and corrects, from Silver with a 'Mein Fehler' ping (attention.json myBad). durS 0 = a single wrong action (flash), noticed at once.
